why: Proposal A delivers the Nordic, light-wood look the client asked for: an ash desk, a birch bentwood rocker and a white bookcase that sit well with the pale floor and white walls. Its only weak spot is the hard shell chair, which isn't really 'cómoda'. Proposal B mixes grey-washed, honey and espresso tones with farmhouse and traditional pieces (rattan doors, wingback), so it drifts from the requested style and doesn't read as one cohesive look.
